snippet.title: LiveStream: Chapter One
snippet.description:
You're a streamer chasing hype and new subscribers, venturing into an abandoned building. The camera is rolling. The chat is buzzing — your viewers are joking, egging you on, waiting for screams.
But what started as a fun livestream from a “haunted spot” quickly turns into something else.
Minute by minute, you're pulled deeper — into someone else's game.
Someone is watching.
Someone has been waiting for you.
